{"type":"text","timestamp":1792350719827,"sessionID":"ses_eaf927fa7ffeKI53gOWcjGPtwa","part":{"id":"prt_1506d819e001WAXwT77vCllNbi_text-0","sessionID":"ses_eaf927fa7ffeKI53gOWcjGPtwa","messageID":"msg_1506d819e001WAXwT77vCllNbi","type":"text","text":"{\"summary\":\"Replace the sorting-based deduplication in uniqueStable with a first-occurrence-preserving loop.\",\"files\":[{\"path\":\"src/unique.js\",\"content\":\"/** Return each value once, preserving its first occurrence order. */\\nexport function uniqueStable(values) {\\n  const seen = new Set();\\n  const result = [];\\n  for (const value of values) {\\n    if (!seen.has(value)) {\\n      seen.add(value);\\n      result.push(value);\\n    }\\n  }\\n  return result;\\n}\\n\"}]}","time":{"start":1792350716324,"end":1792350719827}}}
